name: What is the process for getting a roofing estimate?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting a roofing estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our roofing estimate process begins with a free, on-site consultation. A project manager will visit your property to assess the current condition of your roof, take measurements, and discuss your specific needs and preferences. We'll then provide a detailed proposal outlining material options, labor costs, and a project timeline. This ensures full transparency and helps you make an informed decision without any pressure.
acceptedAnswer.description: We start with a free on-site consultation to assess your roof and discuss needs. You'll then receive a detailed proposal.
